## About

Welcome! I am a sociology PhD Student at the [European University Institute](https://example.edu). 

I study *the formation and effects of normative attitudes, norms and perception*, focusing on *fairness attitudes towards economic inequality*. 

In my PHD thesis I’m interested in understanding how bottom-up processes, such as attitudes, interactions, and practices by ordinary people in everyday life, lead to today’s economic inequalities. For this I mainly use *quantitative methods*, such as survey experiments and observational data analysis.

On this website, you can find more about my [research](research.qmd) and ongoing projects, as well as my [CV](cv.qmd).

I'm happy to chat about research, common interests, so please feel free to reach out to me at [you@university.edu](mailto:you@university.edu).
